text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, fall in linne☆
Attention~~, bow.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to it~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~â¡ How's everyone doing~?
Let's have some fun training today tooâ¡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Yaaaaaay♡)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Ha!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah... huh... a dream?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after bringing her three years
in the Twinkle Series to a close.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yep.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Like, there were soooo many cheerful, earnest, and tiny Umamusume gathered at the training grounds~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I've been having dreams where I'm their instructor!
And lately, I've been getting them quite a bit~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It might sound strange, yes... but given her current position, you can't entirely rule out that possibility for the future.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And instead? What about that dream I've been watching foreeever, shining bright from winning all those GⅠs?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen it at all lately.
Did you move on to a new dream or something~?
choice_data_list: Maybe she's having a change of heart?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They say dreams reflect the subconscious.
If "guiding others" has become a new dream
for Fusaichi Pandora right now, then...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I guess so.
I was thinking the same thing about myself.
choice_data_list: ...Do you want to become an instructor?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I wonder. I guess
I am interested... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Until now, you know,
Ai-chan was the only one I wanted to guide.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I mean, y'know, how should I put it—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
She was the one who brought light into a pitch-black world.
That's why she was so special.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Still, now that I've seen things through to the end for now,
and now that my new dream has probably come true too, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Copying me?
When I see my juniors running like that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡
I just got all, like, itching to go.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's different from the burning feeling I get with Ai-chan!
It's more like a buzzing, fluffy kind of feelingâ
it just makes me want to do something for her!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Even if these girls aren't honor students, aren't geniuses,
and are just ordinary Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "I just thought it'd be nice to run until I'm satisfied, thinking, 'Oh well☆ Let's just have fun and do our best~'"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Aha♡ Right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer!
I'm counting on lots more support from now on~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "dream" of reaching the pinnacle of strength is passed down through many different paths.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mighty "Sun" shining high in the heavens.
The power it shares is strong and brilliant,
illuminating all, yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful "flower" blooming upon the earth.
There is a strength that is quietly passed down
through each of its generations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From flower to flower.
Taking flight, that "dream" soars—

text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text: And the center of today's Winning Live is, of course... none other than—!!

text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text:
"Most GⅠ wins in Japanese history!
Captivating all who watch with her dazzling miracles, the new Queen!"

text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text: That name is—

text_block_list.name: Live MC
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: A white butterfly—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ? Ah... Was it a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Mnh-mnh...
Ai, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I woke you up, didn't I?
It's nothing, just—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I just had such a... warm dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dreams change, woven together.
From the distant past to the far-off future.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*! Ready to go, off I heading!
First, one all-out run—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...I'm off, so make sure you take care of *that*, okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: A special little reward♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Embracing a shining white 'Hope'.
